adjudication.rationale: In `app/models/topic_embed.rb` the URL scheme gate is `return unless url =~ /^https?\:\/\//`. In Ruby, `^` is a line anchor (can match after `\n`), and `=~` searches for a match anywhere in the string. So a multi-line value like `"javascript:alert(1)//\nhttp://x/"` would still match on the second line and bypass the intended scheme restriction. Using `\Ahttps?://` would correctly anchor to the start of the whole string.
